created_prompt: Please help produce a structured, sustainable three-year plan tailored to a woman who wants to grow her online platform and eventually publish a cookbook. The woman currently has 1.2 million followers online and she is known for her healthy and easy recipes. Please note that there is not a preference for how the cookbook may be published (traditional or self-publishing are both fine). The plan must be progressive enough to really drive growth, but it has to be sustainable and appropriate for her lifestyle which involves working 4 days a week and with a limited budget.
